summary: Diff adds a Motoko backend actor with profile auto-creation and post creation (with optional blob), plus a React frontend with Internet Identity gating, routes (Feed/Create/Profile), theme styling, and hooks for feed/profile/post operations. Several REQ-2 backend data/upgrade/media-metadata/limits items are not evidenced, and required generated image assets are not present in the shown diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend persists posts and user profiles across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns (no additional actors).
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows in-memory Maps for profiles/posts but no stable variables or preupgrade/postupgrade logic is evidenced in the truncated file.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each post includes: id, author principal, createdAt, caption text, and optional media metadata (type, filename, byte size).
missing_requirements.reason: The Post type shown uses fields {id, author, content, image, timestamp} and the createPost signature takes (content: Text, image: ?Storage.ExternalBlob) with no explicit media metadata fields (MIME/type, filename, byte size).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend enforces upload limits (max size and allowed MIME types) and returns clear errors when exceeded.
missing_requirements.reason: No upload-size or MIME-type checks (or clear error returns) are evidenced in the shown portion of backend/main.mo; only frontend-side validation is shown.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/role-based access control initialization via a secret URL parameter (caffeineAdminToken) and backend access-control initialization call.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention admin tokens, secret URL parameters, or access-control initialization flows; it only requires Internet Identity authentication.

hallucinated_features.description: Post deletion capability (UI + hook calling actor.deletePost).
hallucinated_features.reason: Delete-post behavior is not requested in the requirements/non-goals; the spec only requires creating and browsing posts and profile editing.
